system.description:
The volley archers of the Boldock Wall and Westfront Fort: coordinated fire from the battlements.

  • Volley Timing: one bow hit of your choice each round on a creature an ally has hit since your last turn ignores its resistances.
    • 9th level: that hit also deals an extra weapon damage die.
  • Sentry's Patience: Advantage on Perception checks on watch or sentry duty.
